About Patrianna
 Patrianna is a fast-scaling product development company headquartered in Gibraltar, with a dynamic, global team powering our growth. We operate at the intersection of technology and entertainment, building innovative solutions that shape the future of social gaming and deliver outstanding experiences to millions of players worldwide.
We're driven by speed, ambition, and bold ideas. At our core, we're product creators and problem-solvers who thrive in a high-performance environment. We're looking for exceptional talent—smart, adaptable, and motivated individuals eager to make an impact, scale business functions at pace, and continuously improve.
Whether you're a domain expert or an agile thinker who thrives in change, at Patrianna you'll have the freedom to innovate, take ownership, and help us lead the next wave of gaming innovation.
Join us—and be part of something extraordinary.
 The Role
 We're looking for a Payment & Fraud Data Analyst to own the data, sharpen the insights, and directly drive payment performance and fraud mitigation across our global gaming platform.
 What You Will Be Doing
Analyse and report on payment performance using SQL and BI tools (Tableau, PowerBI or Looker), building dashboards that inform real decisions.
Reduce payment failures by identifying decline trends, developing recovery strategies, and implementing targeted fixes that move the needle on transaction success rates.
Lead fraud and risk analysis — from chargeback trend investigation to building detection logic for bonus abuse, multi-accounting, and synthetic identities.
Collaborate with the Fraud team to develop risk-scoring models that protect the business without creating friction for genuine players.
Design and analyse A/B tests, translating results into clear, actionable recommendations that improve payment and fraud outcomes.
Report on key metrics and test outcomes to cross-functional teams including Payments, Fraud, and Product — clearly, concisely, and on time.
 What We Are Looking For
Strong, hands-on SQL skills and proven experience building dashboards and reports in Tableau, PowerBI, or Looker.
A solid track record in payments and fraud analytics within the gaming industry — you understand the landscape, the risks, and what good looks like.
Demonstrated experience in payment success rate optimisation, chargeback mitigation, and fraud detection logic.
Comfortable designing and interpreting A/B tests, with the ability to turn data into clear strategic recommendations.
A natural collaborator who communicates directly and works seamlessly across product, fraud, and payment teams.
Python and AutoML exposure is a bonus — not essential, but it'll set you apart.
 Why you will love it
 Patrianna moves fast, cuts through the noise, and builds things that matter. You'll be working as a core member of a lean, high-performing BI team where your work has real, visible impact — not buried in a backlog or lost in committee.
We're a remote-first, international team with a no-nonsense culture: direct communication, genuine accountability, and a shared drive to do great work. We don't do politics or unnecessary process. We do transparency, ownership, and progress.
If you want to build something you're proud of, with people who care about quality as much as you do — this is the place.
We hire based on skills, drive, and ideas — nothing else. Your background, gender, age, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, or educational path will never be a barrier to joining us. We also welcome candidates from non-traditional career journeys and value diverse perspectives that challenge conventional thinking. Diversity fuels our innovation, collaboration, and growth, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute their best work and thrive.
